answers.question: How has my resting heart rate changed over the last three months?
answers.text: Over the recent months (from Tue Jun 9 to Mon Aug 31) your resting heart rate averaged 62 beats per minute, with a typical range from 55 bpm to 68 bpm. The weekly averages started at 59 bpm in the week of June 1, rose to a peak of 64 bpm in the week of July 13, then settled to 62 bpm on Mon Aug 31. Over the full period, the baseline average was 62 bpm and the recent average was 62 bpm, yielding a relative change of 0.35 percent. The overall mean was 62 bpm with a median of 62 bpm and a standard deviation of 2 bpm.

answers.question: How did I sleep last week?
answers.text:
During the week of August 24, you slept an average of 7 h 24 m per night, with about 7 h 42 m spent in bed. Your sleep included an average of 1 h 13 m of deep sleep and 1 h 31 m of REM. You woke up on average 2 awakenings times per night, and it took you about 10 m to fall asleep. Your sleep midpoint varied by ± 41 m from Mon Aug 3 to Sun Aug 30 period.

You rated your sleep quality as follows: on Tue Aug 25 you gave it 4out of 5, on Wed Aug 26 4out of 5, on Fri Aug 28 5out of 5, on Sat Aug 29 4out of 5, and on Sun Aug 30 3out of 5.

answers.question: How has my weight changed over the last three months?
answers.text: Over the recent months, your weight has trended upward. Starting at an average of 170.4 lb during the week of June 1, it rose to 178.3 lb by the week of August 24. Across the full period from Tue Jun 2 to Sun Aug 30, your average weight was 173.9 lb, with a minimum of 170 lb and a maximum of 179.2 lb. The baseline average was 173.5 lb while the recent average was 178.2 lb, corresponding to a change of 2.68%. Earlier in the period, from Mon Jun 8 to Sun Jul 19, your average was 172.8 lb, whereas later, from Mon Jul 20 to Sun Aug 30, it was 175.8 lb.
